mutable struct ParseNode
    symbol::String
    mark::String
    children::Vector{ParseNode}
end
ParseNode(symbol) = ParseNode(symbol,"",ParseNode[])
function parse_tokens(tokens,g,sets,table)
    input = vcat(tokens,[(END_MARKER,length(tokens)+1)])
    root = ParseNode(g.start)
    stack = Tuple{String,Union{Nothing,ParseNode}}[(END_MARKER,nothing),(g.start,root)]
    cursor,step = 1,0
    left_parse,traces,events = Int[],NamedTuple[],NamedTuple[]
    counts = Dict(name=>0 for name in ("predict","match","skip","pop","missing","max_stack"))
    while true
        step += 1
        top,node = stack[end]
        current,position = input[cursor]
        counts["max_stack"] = max(counts["max_stack"],length(stack))
        before_stack,before_input = [item[1] for item in stack],[item[1] for item in input[cursor:end]]
        terminate,event = false,""
        if top==END_MARKER && current==END_MARKER
            action = "accept"
            terminate = true
        elseif top==END_MARKER
            action,event = "error: skip $current","skip"
            cursor += 1
        elseif !is_nonterminal(top)
            if top==current
                action = "match $current"
                pop!(stack)
                cursor += 1
                counts["match"] += 1
            else
                action,event = "error: missing $top","missing"
                node.mark = "missing"
                pop!(stack)
            end
        elseif haskey(table.choices,(top,current))
            number = table.choices[(top,current)]
            p = table.productions[number]
            action = "predict $number: $(p.notation)"
            push!(left_parse,number)
            pop!(stack)
            if isempty(p.rhs)
                push!(node.children,ParseNode("%empty"))
            else
                children = ParseNode.(p.rhs)
                append!(node.children,children)
                for child in reverse(children)
                    push!(stack,(child.symbol,child))
                end
            end
            counts["predict"] += 1
        elseif current==END_MARKER || current in sets.follow[top]
            action,event = "error: pop $top","pop"
            node.mark = "error"
            pop!(stack)
        else
            action,event = "error: skip $current","skip"
            cursor += 1
        end
        push!(traces,(step=step,stack=before_stack,input=before_input,action=action))
        if !isempty(event)
            counts[event] += 1
            push!(events,(step=step,kind=event,symbol=top,token=current,position=position))
        end
        terminate && break
    end
    (root=root,trace=traces,left_parse=left_parse,events=events,counts=counts)
end

terminal_order(terms) = vcat(
    sort([t for t in terms if t!=END_MARKER]),
    END_MARKER in terms ? [END_MARKER] : String[]
)
terminals_of(g) = Set(s for lhs in g.order for rhs in g.rules[lhs] for s in rhs if !is_nonterminal(s))
function first_sequence(rhs,nullable,firsts)
    found = Set{String}()
    for symbol in rhs
        if !is_nonterminal(symbol)
            push!(found,symbol)
            return found,false
        end
        union!(found,firsts[symbol])
        nullable[symbol] || return found,false
    end
    found,true
end
function analyze_sets(g)
    nullable = Dict(lhs=>false for lhs in g.order)
    firsts,follow = Dict(lhs=>Set{String}() for lhs in g.order),Dict(lhs=>Set{String}() for lhs in g.order)
    push!(follow[g.start],END_MARKER)
    passes = Dict{String,Int}()
    for kind in ("nullable","first","follow")
        count = 0
        while true
            count += 1
            changed = false
            for lhs in g.order
                if kind=="nullable"
                    if !nullable[lhs] && any(rhs->all(s->is_nonterminal(s) && nullable[s],rhs),g.rules[lhs])
                        nullable[lhs] = true
                        changed = true
                    end
                else
                    for rhs in g.rules[lhs]
                        if kind=="first"
                            more,_ = first_sequence(rhs,nullable,firsts)
                            if !issubset(more,firsts[lhs])
                                union!(firsts[lhs],more)
                                changed = true
                            end
                        else
                            for (i,symbol) in enumerate(rhs)
                                is_nonterminal(symbol) || continue
                                more,empty = first_sequence(rhs[i+1:end],nullable,firsts)
                                empty && union!(more,follow[lhs])
                                if !issubset(more,follow[symbol])
                                    union!(follow[symbol],more)
                                    changed = true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            changed || break
        end
        passes[kind] = count
    end
    (nullable=nullable,first=firsts,follow=follow,passes=passes,terminals=terminal_order(terminals_of(g)))
end

const END_MARKER = "\$"
struct Grammar
    order::Vector{String}
    rules::Dict{String,Vector{Vector{String}}}
    start::String
end
struct GrammarToken
    kind::Symbol
    value::String
    start::Int
    finish::Int
end
is_nonterminal(symbol) = startswith(symbol,"<") && endswith(symbol,">")
format_alternative(symbols) = isempty(symbols) ? "%empty" : join(symbols," ")
format_production(symbol,alternative) = symbol*" -> "*format_alternative(alternative)
function lex_line(line)
    tokens = GrammarToken[]
    i = 1
    while i<=ncodeunits(line)
        if line[i]==' '
            i += 1
            continue
        end
        line[i]=='#' && break
        start = i
        kind,value = :invalid,string(line[i])
        suffix = line[i:end]
        if line[i]=='<'
            found = match(r"^<[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*>",suffix)
            if !isnothing(found)
                kind,value = :nonterminal,String(found.match)
                i += ncodeunits(value)
            else
                i += 1
            end
        elseif line[i]=='"'
            j = i+1
            while j<=ncodeunits(line) && !(line[j] in (' ','"'))
                j += 1
            end
            if j>i+1 && j<=ncodeunits(line) && line[j]=='"'
                kind,value = :terminal,line[i+1:j-1]
                i = j+1
            else
                i += 1
            end
        elseif isletter(line[i])
            found = match(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*",suffix)
            kind,value = :word,String(found.match)
            i += ncodeunits(value)
        elseif startswith(suffix,"::=")
            kind,value = :definition,"::="
            i += 3
        elseif line[i]=='|'
            kind,value = :separator,"|"
            i += 1
        elseif line[i]=='%'
            directive = String(match(r"^%[A-Za-z]*",suffix).match)
            if directive in ("%empty","%start","%token")
                kind,value = :directive,directive
                i += ncodeunits(directive)
            else
                i += 1
            end
        else
            i += 1
        end
        push!(tokens,GrammarToken(kind,value,start,i-1))
        kind==:invalid && break
    end
    tokens
end
error_column(tokens,cursor) = cursor<=length(tokens) ? tokens[cursor].start : tokens[end].finish+1
function alternative_list(tokens,cursor)
    alternatives = Vector{String}[]
    while true
        cursor>length(tokens) && return alternatives,error_column(tokens,cursor)
        token = tokens[cursor]
        if token.kind==:directive && token.value=="%empty"
            alternative = String[]
            cursor += 1
        elseif token.kind in (:nonterminal,:terminal,:word)
            alternative = String[]
            while cursor<=length(tokens) && tokens[cursor].kind in (:nonterminal,:terminal,:word)
                push!(alternative,tokens[cursor].value)
                cursor += 1
            end
        else
            return alternatives,error_column(tokens,cursor)
        end
        push!(alternatives,alternative)
        cursor>length(tokens) && return alternatives,0
        tokens[cursor].kind!=:separator && return alternatives,error_column(tokens,cursor)
        cursor += 1
    end
end
function parse_line(tokens)
    isempty(tokens) && return (kind=:blank,lhs="",alternatives=Vector{String}[],error=0)
    token = tokens[1]
    if token.kind==:nonterminal
        (length(tokens)<2 || tokens[2].kind!=:definition) && return (
            kind=:rule,
            lhs="",
            alternatives=Vector{String}[],
            error=error_column(tokens,2)
        )
        alternatives,error = alternative_list(tokens,3)
        return (kind=:rule,lhs=token.value,alternatives=alternatives,error=error)
    elseif token.kind==:separator
        alternatives,error = alternative_list(tokens,2)
        return (kind=:continuation,lhs="",alternatives=alternatives,error=error)
    elseif token.kind==:directive && token.value=="%start"
        cursor = length(tokens)<2 || tokens[2].kind!=:nonterminal ? 2 : length(tokens)>2 ? 3 : 0
        return (
            kind=:start,
            lhs=cursor==0 ? tokens[2].value : "",
            alternatives=Vector{String}[],
            error=cursor==0 ? 0 : error_column(tokens,cursor)
        )
    elseif token.kind==:directive && token.value=="%token"
        bad = length(tokens)<2 ? 2 : 0
        if length(tokens)>=2
            bad = findfirst(t->t.kind!=:word,tokens[2:end])
            bad = isnothing(bad) ? 0 : bad+1
        end
        words = bad==0 ? [t.value for t in tokens[2:end]] : String[]
        return (kind=:declaration,lhs="",alternatives=[words],error=bad==0 ? 0 : error_column(tokens,bad))
    end
    (kind=:invalid,lhs="",alternatives=Vector{String}[],error=token.start)
end
function parse_grammar()
    order,rules = String[],Dict{String,Vector{Vector{String}}}()
    start,attachment = "",""
    declared,word_lines,diagnostics = Set{String}(),Dict{String,Int}(),String[]
    has_declaration = false
    for (line_number,line) in enumerate(readlines("input/grammar.bnf"))
        tokens = lex_line(line)
        parsed = parse_line(tokens)
        if parsed.error!=0
            push!(diagnostics,"line $line_number: syntax error at column $(parsed.error)")
            attachment = ""
            continue
        end
        kind,lhs = parsed.kind,parsed.lhs
        kind==:blank && continue
        if kind==:rule
            attachment = lhs
            if !haskey(rules,lhs)
                push!(order,lhs)
                rules[lhs] = Vector{String}[]
            end
        elseif kind==:continuation
            if isempty(attachment)
                push!(diagnostics,"line $line_number: continuation without a rule")
                continue
            end
            lhs = attachment
        elseif kind==:start
            attachment = ""
            if isempty(start)
                start = lhs
            else
                push!(diagnostics,"line $line_number: duplicate %start")
            end
        else
            attachment = ""
            has_declaration = true
            union!(declared,parsed.alternatives[1])
        end
        if kind in (:rule,:continuation)
            for token in tokens
                token.kind==:word && get!(word_lines,token.value,line_number)
            end
            for alternative in parsed.alternatives
                if alternative in rules[lhs]
                    push!(
                        diagnostics,
                        "line $line_number: duplicate alternative $(format_production(lhs,alternative))"
                    )
                else
                    push!(rules[lhs],alternative)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    (
        grammar=Grammar(order,rules,isempty(start) ? order[1] : start),
        declared=declared,
        words=word_lines,
        has_declaration=has_declaration,
        diagnostics=diagnostics
    )
end

include("grammar_parser.jl")
include("transform.jl")
include("first_follow.jl")
include("table.jl")
include("driver.jl")
listed(heading,items) = heading*join((" $item" for item in items))
function reachable(g)
    seen,queue = Set([g.start]),[g.start]
    cursor = 1
    while cursor<=length(queue)
        lhs = queue[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        for rhs in g.rules[lhs],s in rhs
            if is_nonterminal(s) && !(s in seen)
                push!(seen,s)
                push!(queue,s)
            end
        end
    end
    seen
end
function retain_grammar(g,names)
    Grammar(names,Dict(lhs=>g.rules[lhs] for lhs in names),g.start)
end
function clean_grammar(grammar)
    g,diagnostics = clone_grammar(grammar),String[]
    defined = Set(g.order)
    undefined = Set(s for lhs in g.order for rhs in g.rules[lhs] for s in rhs if is_nonterminal(s) && !(s in defined))
    append!(diagnostics,["undefined nonterminal $name" for name in sort(collect(undefined);by=s->s[2:end-1])])
    for lhs in g.order
        kept = Vector{String}[]
        for rhs in g.rules[lhs]
            bad = findfirst(s->s in undefined,rhs)
            if isnothing(bad)
                push!(kept,rhs)
            else
                push!(diagnostics,"removed $(format_production(lhs,rhs)) (undefined $(rhs[bad]))")
            end
        end
        g.rules[lhs] = kept
    end
    productive = Set{String}()
    while true
        changed = false
        for lhs in g.order
            if !(lhs in productive) && any(
                rhs->all(s->!is_nonterminal(s) || s in productive,rhs),
                g.rules[lhs]
            )
                push!(productive,lhs)
                changed = true
            end
        end
        changed || break
    end
    removed = setdiff(Set(g.order),productive)
    append!(diagnostics,["unproductive nonterminal $lhs" for lhs in g.order if lhs in removed])
    g = retain_grammar(g,[lhs for lhs in g.order if !(lhs in removed)])
    for lhs in g.order
        kept = Vector{String}[]
        for rhs in g.rules[lhs]
            bad = findfirst(s->s in removed,rhs)
            if isnothing(bad)
                push!(kept,rhs)
            else
                push!(diagnostics,"removed $(format_production(lhs,rhs)) (unproductive $(rhs[bad]))")
            end
        end
        g.rules[lhs] = kept
    end
    reached = reachable(g)
    append!(diagnostics,["unreachable nonterminal $lhs" for lhs in g.order if !(lhs in reached)])
    retain_grammar(g,[lhs for lhs in g.order if lhs in reached]),diagnostics
end
function left_recursion_diagnostics(g)
    diagnostics = String[]
    for start in g.order
        queue,parent = [start],Dict(start=>"")
        cursor,found = 1,false
        while cursor<=length(queue) && !found
            lhs = queue[cursor]
            cursor += 1
            for rhs in g.rules[lhs]
                (isempty(rhs) || !is_nonterminal(rhs[1])) && continue
                next = rhs[1]
                if next==start
                    path = [lhs]
                    while !isempty(parent[path[end]])
                        push!(path,parent[path[end]])
                    end
                    push!(diagnostics,"left recursion: "*join(vcat(reverse(path),[start])," -> "))
                    found = true
                    break
                elseif !haskey(parent,next)
                    parent[next] = lhs
                    push!(queue,next)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    diagnostics
end
function grammar_summary(g)
    alternatives = [rhs for lhs in g.order for rhs in g.rules[lhs]]
    "start=$(g.start) nonterminals=$(length(g.order)) terminals=$(length(terminals_of(g))) productions=$(length(alternatives)) empty=$(count(isempty,alternatives)) unit=$(count(rhs->length(rhs)==1 && is_nonterminal(rhs[1]),alternatives))"
end
function grammar_listing(g;numbered=false)
    lines = String[]
    total = sum(length(g.rules[lhs]) for lhs in g.order)
    width,number = length(string(total)),0
    for lhs in g.order,(i,rhs) in enumerate(g.rules[lhs])
        number += 1
        line = i==1 ? format_production(lhs,rhs) : repeat(" ",length(lhs))*" | "*format_alternative(rhs)
        push!(lines,numbered ? lpad(number,width)*"  "*line : line)
    end
    lines
end
function grammar_report(cleaned,recursion,factored,final,recursion_log,factor_log,final_log)
    lines = vcat(["== cleaned grammar ==",grammar_summary(cleaned)],grammar_listing(cleaned))
    for (title,g,log,numbered) in (
        ("left recursion elimination",recursion,recursion_log,false),
        ("left factoring",factored,factor_log,false),
        ("final grammar",final,final_log,true)
    )
        append!(lines,["","== $title =="])
        append!(lines,isempty(log) ? ["none"] : log)
        push!(lines,grammar_summary(g))
        append!(lines,grammar_listing(g;numbered=numbered))
    end
    append!(lines,["","== cross reference =="])
    productions = number_productions(final)
    for symbol in vcat(final.order,terminal_order(terminals_of(final)))
        numbers = [p.number for p in productions if symbol in p.rhs]
        name = is_nonterminal(symbol) ? symbol : "\"$symbol\""
        push!(lines,isempty(numbers) ? "$name not used" : listed("$name used in",numbers))
    end
    lines
end
function sequence_measure(rhs,scores)
    length,height = 0,0
    for s in rhs
        if is_nonterminal(s)
            haskey(scores,s) || return nothing
            length += scores[s][1]
            height = max(height,scores[s][2])
        else
            length += 1
        end
    end
    (length,height+1)
end
function expand_sequence(rhs,sentences)
    result = String[]
    for s in rhs
        append!(result,is_nonterminal(s) ? sentences[s] : [s])
    end
    result
end
function shortest_sentences(g)
    scores = Dict{String,Tuple{Int,Int}}()
    while true
        changed = false
        for lhs in g.order,rhs in g.rules[lhs]
            measure = sequence_measure(rhs,scores)
            isnothing(measure) && continue
            if !haskey(scores,lhs) || measure<scores[lhs]
                scores[lhs] = measure
                changed = true
            end
        end
        changed || break
    end
    sentences = Dict{String,Vector{String}}()
    for lhs in sort(g.order;by=lhs->scores[lhs][2])
        selected = first(rhs for rhs in g.rules[lhs] if sequence_measure(rhs,scores)==scores[lhs])
        sentences[lhs] = expand_sequence(selected,sentences)
    end
    scores,sentences
end
function shortest_contexts(g,scores,sentences)
    costs = Dict(g.start=>(0,0))
    parents = Dict{String,Any}()
    productions = number_productions(g)
    while true
        changed = false
        for p in productions
            haskey(costs,p.lhs) || continue
            for (k,s) in enumerate(p.rhs)
                (!is_nonterminal(s) || s==g.start) && continue
                before,after = p.rhs[1:k-1],p.rhs[k+1:end]
                extra = sum((is_nonterminal(x) ? scores[x][1] : 1 for x in vcat(before,after));init=0)
                candidate = (costs[p.lhs][1]+extra,costs[p.lhs][2]+1)
                key = (p.number,k)
                if !haskey(costs,s) || candidate<costs[s] || (candidate==costs[s] && key<parents[s].key)
                    costs[s] = candidate
                    parents[s] = (key=key,lhs=p.lhs,before=before,after=after)
                    changed = true
                end
            end
        end
        changed || break
    end
    contexts = Dict(g.start=>(String[],String[]))
    for s in sort([s for s in g.order if s!=g.start];by=s->costs[s][2])
        parent = parents[s]
        pre,post = contexts[parent.lhs]
        contexts[s] = (
            vcat(pre,expand_sequence(parent.before,sentences)),
            vcat(expand_sequence(parent.after,sentences),post)
        )
    end
    contexts
end
function sets_report(g,sets,sentences)
    passes = sets.passes
    lines = ["passes: nullable=$(passes["nullable"]) first=$(passes["first"]) follow=$(passes["follow"])",""]
    for lhs in g.order
        append!(lines,[lhs,"  nullable: "*(sets.nullable[lhs] ? "yes" : "no"),listed("  first:",terminal_order(sets.first[lhs])),
            listed("  follow:",terminal_order(sets.follow[lhs])),listed("  shortest:",sentences[lhs])])
    end
    lines
end
function first_path(number,token,table,sets)
    queue,parent = [number],Dict(number=>0)
    cursor = 1
    while cursor<=length(queue)
        current = queue[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        for s in table.productions[current].rhs
            if s==token
                path = Int[]
                while current!=number
                    push!(path,current)
                    current = parent[current]
                end
                return reverse(path)
            elseif is_nonterminal(s)
                for p in table.productions
                    if p.lhs==s && !haskey(parent,p.number)
                        parent[p.number] = current
                        push!(queue,p.number)
                    end
                end
                sets.nullable[s] || break
            else
                break
            end
        end
    end
    Int[]
end
function follow_path(lhs,token,g,table,sets)
    queue,paths = [lhs],Dict(lhs=>Int[])
    cursor = 1
    while cursor<=length(queue)
        symbol = queue[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        path = paths[symbol]
        symbol==g.start && token==END_MARKER && return path
        for p in table.productions,(i,s) in enumerate(p.rhs)
            s==symbol || continue
            more,empty = first_sequence(p.rhs[i+1:end],sets.nullable,sets.first)
            token in more && return vcat(path,[p.number])
            if empty && !haskey(paths,p.lhs)
                paths[p.lhs] = vcat(path,[p.number])
                push!(queue,p.lhs)
            end
        end
    end
    Int[]
end
function table_report(g,sets,table,before)
    lines = ["== predict sets =="]
    for p in table.productions
        append!(lines,["$(p.number): $(p.notation)",listed("  predict:",terminal_order(keys(p.predict)))])
    end
    append!(lines,["","== parse table =="])
    tokens = vcat(sets.terminals,[END_MARKER])
    matrix = [vcat([""],tokens)]
    for lhs in g.order
        values = [isempty(table.cells[(lhs,t)]) ? "." : join(
            (entry.number for entry in table.cells[(lhs,t)]),
            "/"
        ) for t in tokens]
        push!(matrix,vcat([lhs],values))
    end
    widths = [maximum(length(row[j]) for row in matrix) for j in eachindex(matrix[1])]
    for row in matrix
        push!(lines,rpad(row[1],widths[1])*join(("  "*lpad(row[j],widths[j]) for j in 2:length(row))))
    end
    append!(lines,["","== conflicts =="])
    isempty(table.conflicts) && push!(lines,"none")
    for conflict in table.conflicts
        lhs,token = conflict.lhs,conflict.token
        push!(lines,"conflict $lhs on $token: $(conflict.kind), chosen $(conflict.chosen)")
        for entry in conflict.entries
            p = table.productions[entry.number]
            path = entry.reason=="FIRST" ? first_path(
                p.number,
                token,
                table,
                sets
            ) : follow_path(lhs,token,g,table,sets)
            reason = entry.reason*(isempty(path) ? "" : listed(" via",path))
            push!(lines,"  $(p.number): $(p.notation) ($reason)")
        end
    end
    append!(
        lines,
        ["LL(1): "*(isempty(table.conflicts) ? "yes" : "no"),"conflicts before transformation: $before"]
    )
    lines
end
function compact_tree(root)
    children = ParseNode[]
    for original in root.children
        original.symbol=="%empty" && continue
        child = compact_tree(original)
        if is_nonterminal(child.symbol) && isempty(child.mark) && isempty(child.children)
            continue
        elseif is_nonterminal(child.symbol) && occursin("'",child.symbol) && isempty(child.mark)
            append!(children,child.children)
        else
            push!(children,child)
        end
    end
    length(children)==1 && isempty(root.mark) ? children[1] : ParseNode(root.symbol,root.mark,children)
end
tree_label(node) = node.symbol*(isempty(node.mark) ? "" : " ($(node.mark))")
function tree_lines(root)
    lines = [tree_label(root)]
    pending = Tuple{ParseNode,String,Bool}[]
    for i in length(root.children):-1:1
        push!(pending,(root.children[i],"",i==length(root.children)))
    end
    while !isempty(pending)
        node,prefix,last_child = pop!(pending)
        push!(lines,prefix*(last_child ? "`-- " : "|-- ")*tree_label(node))
        next_prefix = prefix*(last_child ? "    " : "|   ")
        for i in length(node.children):-1:1
            push!(pending,(node.children[i],next_prefix,i==length(node.children)))
        end
    end
    lines
end
function trace_lines(trace)
    rows = vcat(
        [("step","stack","input","action")],
        [(string(row.step),join(row.stack," "),join(row.input," "),row.action) for row in trace]
    )
    widths = [maximum(length(row[j]) for row in rows) for j in 1:3]
    [join((rpad(row[j],widths[j])*"  " for j in 1:3))*row[4] for row in rows]
end
function error_strings(events,sets,table)
    errors = String[]
    for e in events
        unexpected = e.token==END_MARKER ? "end of input" : "\"$(e.token)\" at token $(e.position)"
        if is_nonterminal(e.symbol)
            names = [t for t in vcat(sets.terminals,[END_MARKER]) if haskey(table.choices,(e.symbol,t))]
            expected = join((t==END_MARKER ? t : "\"$t\"" for t in names)," ")
        else
            expected = e.symbol==END_MARKER ? END_MARKER : "\"$(e.symbol)\""
        end
        recovery = e.kind=="skip" ? "skipped \"$(e.token)\"" : e.kind=="pop" ? "popped $(e.symbol)" : "inserted \"$(e.symbol)\""
        push!(errors,"step $(e.step): unexpected $unexpected; expected $expected; $recovery")
    end
    errors
end
function leftmost_derivation(start,numbers,productions)
    symbols,lines = [start],["  $start"]
    for number in numbers
        position = findfirst(is_nonterminal,symbols)
        splice!(symbols,position:position,productions[number].rhs)
        push!(lines,"  => "*format_alternative(symbols))
    end
    lines
end
function recognize_language(g,tokens)
    productions = number_productions(g)
    rhs(p) = p==0 ? [g.start] : productions[p].rhs
    lhs(p) = p==0 ? "" : productions[p].lhs
    n = length(tokens)
    charts = [Set{NTuple{3,Int}}() for _ in 0:n]
    pending = [NTuple{3,Int}[] for _ in 0:n]
    function add!(position,item)
        if !(item in charts[position+1])
            push!(charts[position+1],item)
            push!(pending[position+1],item)
        end
    end
    add!(0,(0,0,0))
    for position in 0:n
        cursor = 1
        while cursor<=length(pending[position+1])
            p,dot,origin = pending[position+1][cursor]
            cursor += 1
            body = rhs(p)
            if dot==length(body)
                for (a,consumed,start) in copy(pending[origin+1])
                    outer = rhs(a)
                    consumed<length(outer) && outer[consumed+1]==lhs(p) && add!(position,(a,consumed+1,start))
                end
            elseif is_nonterminal(body[dot+1])
                next = body[dot+1]
                for child in productions
                    child.lhs==next && add!(position,(child.number,0,position))
                end
                for (a,consumed,start) in copy(pending[position+1])
                    lhs(a)==next && consumed==length(rhs(a)) && start==position && add!(
                        position,
                        (p,dot+1,origin)
                    )
                end
            elseif position<n && body[dot+1]==tokens[position+1]
                add!(position+1,(p,dot+1,origin))
            end
        end
    end
    (0,1,0) in charts[n+1]
end
function parse_input(tokens,g,sets,table,cleaned)
    kept,unknown = Tuple{String,Int}[],String[]
    for (i,t) in enumerate(tokens)
        if t in sets.terminals
            push!(kept,(t,i))
        else
            push!(unknown,"unknown \"$t\" at token $i; removed")
        end
    end
    parsed = parse_tokens(kept,g,sets,table)
    errors = vcat(unknown,error_strings(parsed.events,sets,table))
    (
        ;parsed...,
        original=tokens,
        unknown=unknown,
        errors=errors,
        accepted=isempty(errors),
        language=recognize_language(cleaned,tokens)
    )
end
function parses_report(parses,g,sets,table,sentences,contexts)
    lines = String[]
    for (i,p) in enumerate(parses)
        append!(lines,["== input $i ==",listed("tokens:",p.original)])
        append!(lines,trace_lines(p.trace))
        push!(
            lines,
            listed("left parse:",p.left_parse),
            "stats: steps=$(length(p.trace)) predicts=$(p.counts["predict"]) matches=$(p.counts["match"]) max_stack=$(p.counts["max_stack"])"
        )
        if !isempty(p.errors)
            push!(lines,"errors:")
            append!(lines,["  $error" for error in p.errors])
        end
        push!(
            lines,
            p.accepted ? "result: accepted" : "result: rejected (errors: $(length(p.errors)))",
            "language: "*(p.language ? "yes" : "no")
        )
        if p.accepted
            push!(lines,"derivation:")
            append!(lines,leftmost_derivation(g.start,p.left_parse,table.productions))
        end
        push!(lines,"tree:")
        append!(lines,tree_lines(p.root))
        push!(lines,"compact tree:")
        append!(lines,tree_lines(compact_tree(p.root)))
        push!(lines,"")
    end
    used = Set(number for p in parses for number in p.left_parse)
    unused = [p for p in table.productions if !(p.number in used)]
    accepted,in_language = count(p->p.accepted,parses),count(p->p.language,parses)
    mismatches = [i for (i,p) in enumerate(parses) if p.accepted!=p.language]
    push!(lines,"== summary ==","inputs=$(length(parses)) accepted=$accepted rejected=$(length(parses)-accepted) in_language=$in_language",listed("mismatches:",mismatches),
        "recovery: unknown=$(sum(length(p.unknown) for p in parses)) skip=$(sum(p.counts["skip"] for p in parses)) pop=$(sum(p.counts["pop"] for p in parses)) missing=$(sum(p.counts["missing"] for p in parses))",
        "coverage: $(length(used)) of $(length(table.productions)) productions used",listed(
            "unused:",
            [p.number for p in unused]
        ))
    for p in unused
        prefix,suffix = contexts[p.lhs]
        sentence = vcat(prefix,expand_sequence(p.rhs,sentences),suffix)
        parsed = parse_tokens([(word,i) for (i,word) in enumerate(sentence)],g,sets,table)
        errors = length(parsed.events)
        push!(lines,"  $(p.number): $(p.notation)",listed("    example:",sentence),errors==0 ? "    result: accepted" : "    result: rejected (errors: $errors)",
            "    used: "*(p.number in parsed.left_parse ? "yes" : "no"))
    end
    lines
end
function main()
    source = parse_grammar()
    cleaned,clean_diags = clean_grammar(source.grammar)
    recursion_diags = left_recursion_diagnostics(cleaned)
    recursion,recursion_log = eliminate_left_recursion(cleaned)
    factored,factor_log = left_factor(recursion)
    reached = reachable(factored)
    removed = [lhs for lhs in factored.order if !(lhs in reached)]
    final = retain_grammar(factored,[lhs for lhs in factored.order if lhs in reached])
    final_log = ["remove unreachable $lhs" for lhs in removed]
    diagnostics = copy(source.diagnostics)
    if source.has_declaration
        append!(
            diagnostics,
            ["undeclared terminal $t at line $(source.words[t])" for t in sort(collect(keys(source.words))) if !(t in source.declared)]
        )
    end
    append!(diagnostics,clean_diags)
    append!(diagnostics,recursion_diags)
    append!(diagnostics,["unreachable after transformation $lhs" for lhs in removed])
    if source.has_declaration
        append!(
            diagnostics,
            ["unused token $t" for t in sort(collect(setdiff(source.declared,terminals_of(final))))]
        )
    end
    before = build_table(cleaned,analyze_sets(cleaned))
    sets = analyze_sets(final)
    table = build_table(final,sets)
    scores,sentences = shortest_sentences(final)
    contexts = shortest_contexts(final,scores,sentences)
    inputs = [isempty(line) ? String[] : String.(split(line,' ')) for line in readlines("input/inputs.txt")]
    parses = [parse_input(tokens,final,sets,table,cleaned) for tokens in inputs]
    push!(
        diagnostics,
        isempty(table.conflicts) ? "result: LL(1)" : "result: not LL(1) (conflicts: $(length(table.conflicts)))"
    )
    reports = [("grammar.txt",grammar_report(cleaned,recursion,factored,final,recursion_log,factor_log,final_log)),
        ("sets.txt",sets_report(final,sets,sentences)),(
            "table.txt",
            table_report(final,sets,table,length(before.conflicts))
        ),
        (
            "parses.txt",
            parses_report(parses,final,sets,table,sentences,contexts)
        ),("diagnostics.txt",diagnostics)]
    for (name,lines) in reports
        open(joinpath("output",name),"w") do io
            for line in lines
                println(io,line)
            end
        end
    end
end
main()

function number_productions(g)
    productions = NamedTuple[]
    for lhs in g.order,rhs in g.rules[lhs]
        push!(
            productions,
            (
                number=length(productions)+1,
                lhs=lhs,
                rhs=rhs,
                notation=format_production(lhs,rhs),
                predict=Dict{String,String}()
            )
        )
    end
    productions
end
function build_table(g,sets)
    productions = number_productions(g)
    cells = Dict((lhs,t)=>NamedTuple[] for lhs in g.order for t in vcat(sets.terminals,[END_MARKER]))
    for p in productions
        direct,empty = first_sequence(p.rhs,sets.nullable,sets.first)
        for t in direct
            p.predict[t] = "FIRST"
        end
        if empty
            for t in sets.follow[p.lhs]
                get!(p.predict,t,"FOLLOW")
            end
        end
        for t in terminal_order(keys(p.predict))
            push!(cells[(p.lhs,t)],(number=p.number,reason=p.predict[t]))
        end
    end
    choices = Dict{Tuple{String,String},Int}()
    conflicts = NamedTuple[]
    for lhs in g.order,t in vcat(sets.terminals,[END_MARKER])
        entries = cells[(lhs,t)]
        isempty(entries) && continue
        preferred = findfirst(entry->entry.reason=="FIRST",entries)
        choice = entries[isnothing(preferred) ? 1 : preferred].number
        choices[(lhs,t)] = choice
        if length(entries)>=2
            reasons = Set(entry.reason for entry in entries)
            kind = reasons==Set(["FIRST"]) ? "FIRST/FIRST" : reasons==Set(["FOLLOW"]) ? "FOLLOW/FOLLOW" : "FIRST/FOLLOW"
            push!(conflicts,(lhs=lhs,token=t,kind=kind,entries=entries,chosen=choice))
        end
    end
    (productions=productions,cells=cells,choices=choices,conflicts=conflicts)
end

clone_grammar(g) = Grammar(copy(g.order),Dict(lhs=>deepcopy(g.rules[lhs]) for lhs in g.order),g.start)
function fresh_name(symbol,rules)
    proposed = symbol[1:end-1]*"'>"
    while haskey(rules,proposed)
        proposed = proposed[1:end-1]*"'>"
    end
    proposed
end
function leading_reaches(rules,source,target)
    queue,seen = [source],Set([source])
    cursor = 1
    while cursor<=length(queue)
        current = queue[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        for row in rules[current]
            (isempty(row) || !is_nonterminal(row[1])) && continue
            next = row[1]
            next==target && return true
            if !(next in seen)
                push!(seen,next)
                push!(queue,next)
            end
        end
    end
    false
end
function eliminate_left_recursion(grammar)
    g = clone_grammar(grammar)
    initial,log = copy(g.order),String[]
    for (i,lhs) in enumerate(initial)
        for earlier in initial[1:i-1]
            current = g.rules[lhs]
            if any(row->!isempty(row) && row[1]==earlier,current) && leading_reaches(g.rules,earlier,lhs)
                replacements = Vector{String}[]
                for row in current
                    if !isempty(row) && row[1]==earlier
                        append!(replacements,[vcat(source,row[2:end]) for source in g.rules[earlier]])
                    else
                        push!(replacements,row)
                    end
                end
                g.rules[lhs] = unique(replacements)
                push!(log,"substitute $earlier into $lhs")
            end
        end
        source = Vector{String}[]
        for row in g.rules[lhs]
            if row==[lhs]
                push!(log,"remove cycle $lhs -> $lhs")
            else
                push!(source,row)
            end
        end
        recursive = [row[2:end] for row in source if !isempty(row) && row[1]==lhs]
        if isempty(recursive)
            g.rules[lhs] = source
        else
            ordinary = [row for row in source if isempty(row) || row[1]!=lhs]
            created = fresh_name(lhs,g.rules)
            g.rules[lhs] = [vcat(row,[created]) for row in ordinary]
            g.rules[created] = vcat([vcat(row,[created]) for row in recursive],[String[]])
            insert!(g.order,findfirst(==(lhs),g.order)+1,created)
            push!(log,"eliminate left recursion in $lhs with $created")
        end
    end
    g,log
end
function left_factor(grammar)
    g,log = clone_grammar(grammar),String[]
    position = 1
    while position<=length(g.order)
        lhs = g.order[position]
        current,insertions = g.rules[lhs],String[]
        index = 1
        while index<=length(current)
            row = current[index]
            if isempty(row)
                index += 1
                continue
            end
            group = findall(other->!isempty(other) && other[1]==row[1],current)
            if length(group)==1
                index += 1
                continue
            end
            limit = minimum(length(current[i]) for i in group)
            prefix_length = 0
            while prefix_length<limit && all(i->current[i][prefix_length+1]==row[prefix_length+1],group)
                prefix_length += 1
            end
            prefix = row[1:prefix_length]
            created = fresh_name(lhs,g.rules)
            g.rules[created] = [current[i][prefix_length+1:end] for i in group]
            current = [i==group[1] ? vcat(
                prefix,
                [created]
            ) : alternative for (i,alternative) in enumerate(current) if i==group[1] || !(i in group)]
            g.rules[lhs] = current
            push!(insertions,created)
            push!(log,"left factor $lhs on $(format_alternative(prefix)) with $created")
            index = group[1]+1
        end
        splice!(g.order,position+1:position,insertions)
        position += 1
    end
    g,log
end
